author: Philip K. Dick
card_summary: A five-page scan of Folder 18 of Dick's Exegesis manuscript, dated to August 1978, preserving pages 1 through 5 as raw archival images of the handwritten journal.
page_summary:
This item is a direct scan of five pages from Folder 18 of Dick's Exegesis, assigned to August 1978, a period deep in his years-long effort to interpret the 2-3-74 experiences. Pages 1 through 5 are reproduced here as manuscript images, part of the enormous unpublished journal Dick kept from 1974 until his death.

Its value is documentary rather than interpretive. Unlike the edited Sutin or Jackson-Lethem selections, this scan shows the Exegesis in its unmediated form, letting researchers examine Dick's hand, his page-level flow of argument, and the physical organization of the archive by folder.

The portal preserves one archive manifestation of these pages. It sits alongside the companion scan of pages 6-10 from the same folder and is best consulted next to the published editions and the portal's Exegesis pages at /exegesis, which provide the interpretive context these raw images lack.
